svg.title: Visual Privacy: The Impact of Privacy Labels on Privacy Behaviors Online
svg.desc: Preview card of the accepted paper in ACM Transactions on Social Computing, with its title, authors, and abstract.

g.text: ACM TRANSACTIONS ON SOCIAL COMPUTING
Vol. 9, No. 2 · Article, pp. 1–27 · 2026 · Open Access
Visual Privacy: The Impact
of Privacy Labels on Privacy
Behaviors Online
K. Garcia, A. Tamò-Larrieux, Y. Meier, S.
Mayer, C. Lutz, C. Guitton, L. Stern, R. Rot,
S. Pilz & S. Mulders
ABSTRACT
Research has consistently shown that websites’
privacy policies fail to inform users, prompting
exploration of more condensed, visual solutions such
as icons and privacy labels. We present the Visual
Privacy browser extension, which automatically
computes a privacy rating and visualizes it in a
privacy label, and study its impact on privacy
protection behavior in an online experiment
Open access · CC BY 4.0
